connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.newrelic.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the newrelic-partners account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
